rules.message: The placeholder must enable the extension (data-hx-ext="sse") alongside data-sse-connect.
The streaming placeholder carries aria-busy="true" so chunks never spam the log region — the reply is announced once, when the final swap removes it.
The body is the chunk sink: data-sse-swap on .hc-chat__body with data-hx-swap="beforeend".
The placeholder listens for the final events (data-sse-swap lists done) and replaces itself: data-hx-swap="outerHTML" — that swap is also what closes the EventSource.
The final events replace the whole placeholder: data-hx-swap="outerHTML" on the connect element.
Listen for the error event too (data-sse-swap="done,error") so a failed stream resolves the placeholder instead of leaving it busy forever.
A stop affordance is recommended: a button with data-hx-post to the cancel endpoint, data-hx-target="closest li", data-hx-swap="outerHTML".
